subject: Cohort sync + exit-window proposal for Renewal (ACME Health)
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Mike Barnes <mike.barnes@acmehealth.com>; procurement@acmehealth.com
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Cohort sync + exit-window proposal for Renewal (ACME Health)

Hi Mike / ACME procurement team —

Following our QBR and the usage trends Karthik shared last week, I wanted to put a succinct proposal on the table so procurement has a clear path for your renewal. High level: ACME is approaching contract renewal in Jan 2027, and based on this year's burst patterns we recommend a hybrid multi-year with an explicit ramp schedule and an exit window (no auto-renew lock-in) to preserve flexibility.

Proposal highlights (draft):
- Term: 24 months (Feb 1, 2027 – Jan 31, 2029) with a staged ramp (Year 1: baseline + 30% burst buffer; Year 2: baseline + incremental 40% capacity).
- Billing: Quarterly in arrears, with a true-up at each quarter to align usage and committed capacity.
- Auto-renew: Opt-out by mutual consent; provide a 60-day exit window before renewal to avoid forced auto-renew.
- Pricing: 8% effective discount off list for committing to the 24-month schedule; additional 2% for an annual prepay option.
- Safety net: Two burst credits (convertible within term) to handle emergency spikes without immediate overage charges.

Attached is a short forecast workbook and a first-draft amendment that maps the ramp to committed GPU units (ACME_Renewal_Draft_v1.pdf, usage-forecast-acme.xlsx).

Can you confirm: (1) procurement timeline for signature, (2) whether ACME needs a co-terminus alignment across your other platform vendors, and (3) who needs to review the exit-window language? If helpful I can convert the draft into a short redline for legal.

Thanks —
Irene
Irene Choi
Head of Account Success, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

---
Attachment: ACME_Renewal_Draft_v1.pdf (1 page summary)
Attachment: usage-forecast-acme.xlsx (forecast tab + quarter breakdown)

From: Mike Barnes <mike.barnes@acmehealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: ACME Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 11:06:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Cohort sync + exit-window proposal for Renewal (ACME Health)

Irene — thanks for the draft and the clear options. A couple quick points from procurement and ops: 

1) Timeline: Procurement needs final commercial terms by Dec 10 to make the Jan 1 renewal effective. Legal typically requires a 10-business-day review on the amendment.
2) Exit window: Procurement will push back if the exit-window is too short — is the 60-day window firm? We usually ask for 90 days for large multi-year commitments.
3) Billing: quarterly in arrears is fine, but we need the true-up math explicitly shown (example scenarios for +30% and +70% peak months).

Operationally, our platform team asked whether Redwood can offer a temporary burst pool toggle that we can enable during major launches (we run two product cohorts in May and November). If that exists, it could reduce the required committed headroom in Year 1.

Can we schedule a short call next week (30 min) to align commercial+ops? CC'd procurement to route next steps.

Best,
Mike Barnes
VP, Product Ops — ACME Health
mail: mike.barnes@acmehealth.com | +1 (617) 555-0123

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 08:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Cohort sync + exit-window proposal for Renewal (ACME Health)

Irene / Camila — quick internal notes to align before the call with ACME: 

- Exit window: I agree we can stretch the mutual opt-out window to 90 days for a 24-month commitment. That preserves flexibility for them and is still operationally manageable for us. Let's mark that as an optional concession tied to the 8% discount (if they insist on 90d we can keep discount at 8%).
- Burst pool toggle: We do have a configurable burst pool for Dedicated customers; offering a controlled burst toggle for ACME during launch windows is reasonable but should be timeboxed (30 day activation max per cohort) and managed via SRE runbooks. We should bake that into the amendment as a "Launch Burst" feature with two activations in Year 1 and two in Year 2.
- True-up scenarios: Camila, can you prepare two tiled examples (baseline +30%/baseline +70%) showing invoiced vs committed and how credits apply? We should include an explicit formula in the amendment so procurement can validate quickly.
- DocuSign & legal redline: I'll ask Sales Ops to create the DocuSign envelope once legal approves the redline.

Camila — can you join the call with ACME and walk through the workbook? I'll handle the pricing concessions and the exit-window language.

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Renewals (Redwood)

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Mike Barnes <mike.barnes@acmehealth.com>, ACME Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 15:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Cohort sync + exit-window proposal for Renewal (ACME Health)

Mike / team — thanks for the quick feedback. Per our internal alignment (Karthik & Camila), updated items below and next steps: 

What we updated (see attached revised draft):
- Exit window extended to 90 days (conditional concession for the 24-month term).
- Launch Burst feature: two activations per year, 30 days max per activation; burst usage billed against burst credits first, then overage rates.
- Pricing: 8% off list for 24-month commit; 2% extra if annual prepay is chosen.
- True-up: included explicit math (see workbook scenarios) and samples for +30% and +70% months.

Next steps:
1) Please confirm that the 90-day exit-window + Launch Burst construct addresses ACME's procurement concerns.
2) If yes, procurement: can you provide the legal contact and confirm internal review timeline (we need sign-off by Dec 10 to meet Jan 1 cadence).
3) We'll prepare a redline and DocuSign envelope for legal review immediately after you confirm.

I can host a 30-minute alignment call Thu Nov 19 @ 10:00am ET — please confirm availability or propose an alternative.

Looking forward —
Irene
Head of Account Success, Redwood Inference

Attachment: ACME_Renewal_Draft_v1.pdf (updated v1.1 with exit-window and burst language)
